select FILE_ID as fileId, /*流水号*/ FILE_TYPE as fileType, /*文档类型*/ FILE_NAME as fileName, /*文档名称*/ FILE_PATH as filePath , /*上传路径*/ CREATE_USER as createUser, /*上传人*/ CREATE_DEPT as createDept, /*上传部门*/ CREATE_TIME+0 as uploadTime , /*上传时间*/ UPDATE_USER as updateUser, /*更新人*/ UPDATE_TIME as updateTime /*更新时间*/ FROM BOK_FILE_INFO where 1=1
AND FILE_NAME LIKE '%' || #{fileName} || '%'
AND FILE_TYPE LIKE '%' || #{fileType} || '%'
AND CREATE_USER LIKE '%' || #{createUser} || '%'
AND to_char(CREATE_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') >= #{uploadTimeBegin}
AND to_char(CREATE_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= #{uploadTimeEnd}
order by uploadTime DESC

select FILE_ID as fileNo, /*流水号*/ FILE_TYPE as fileType, /*文档类型*/ FILE_NAME as fileName, /*文档名称*/ FILE_PATH as filePath , /*上传路径*/ CREATE_USER as createUser, /*上传人*/ CREATE_DEPT as createDept, /*上传部门*/ CREATE_TIME+0 as uploadTime , /*上传时间*/ UPDATE_USER as updateUser, /*更新人*/ UPDATE_TIME as updateTime /*更新时间*/ from BOK_FILE_INFO where FILE_ID = #{fileId}
